text: The spin-fade law was derived from a pinned vector perturbation equation and checked by machine algebra. During radiation domination, rotation falls in inverse proportion to cosmic size. During matter and dark energy domination, it falls with the inverse square. The inflation error rate has no pinned source, so it remains an explicit parameter rather than a claimed result. Mapping today's microwave background limit back to galaxy spin-up changes the allowance by only a factor of a few, not enough to rescue it.
